final_message:
I scheduled six practice sessions totaling 4 hours 20 minutes. If you complete them, Milepost projects that all five skills will meet their targets for your cells exam at 2027-03-11T09:00:00-05:00.

2027-03-04T06:40:00-05:00 — Plant and animal cell organelles, 70 minutes
2027-03-05T06:40:00-05:00 — Fluid mosaic model, 30 minutes
2027-03-05T07:20:00-05:00 — How the ER and Golgi make and ship proteins, 35 minutes
2027-03-06T09:30:00-05:00 — Diffusion and osmosis, 60 minutes
2027-03-09T06:40:00-05:00 — Diffusion and osmosis, 35 minutes
2027-03-10T06:40:00-05:00 — Pumps and active transport, 30 minutes

Diffusion and osmosis gets two sessions because it has the largest gap. Active transport is already above target today, but Milepost projects it would slip to 58.2% by exam day. The 30-minute refresher brings its projection to 64.6%, above the 60% target.
